result.subject: Update on product analytics north-star metric
result.body:
Hi CPO,

I hope you’re well. I wanted to touch base on the product analytics north‑star metric we discussed at the Offsite. The original due date was Nov 2, and I see we’re about a week behind. Could you share a quick status update and, if needed, a realistic new completion date? I’m happy to help unblock any challenges. Since this was a Board‑driven initiative, I’d like to have an update ready for the CEO before the next Board meeting on Nov 26.

Thanks,
Business Operations
